input.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Jaunty English countryside folk tune for a sunny meadow level in a 3D platform adventure game. A lively fiddle melody, accordion chords, a tin whistle answering phrases, bouncy upright bass, acoustic guitar strumming, light hand percussion, tambourine and foot stomps. Rolling green hills, windmills and thatched cottages; playful, energetic and cheeky, major key, about 126 BPM, constant groove with no intro fade and no ending, loop-friendly game background music.
